title: Middle School Trip-Group Amounts on Fine Arts Travel Fees — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Trip-group amount, Fine Arts travel fee schedule (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees).** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a trip-group amount is added: minus 40.00 for a participation at a middle school campus whose student's enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06, minus 20.00 for a participation at a middle school campus whose student's enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 07 or 08, and nothing otherwise.

The participation's campus is the campus whose program the student joins; the middle school campuses are Hollis Middle School and Ridgecrest Middle School. The grade comes from the student's enrollment record for the school year in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

| Participation at a middle school campus? | Grade on the enrollment record | Trip-group amount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 06 | minus 40.00 |
| yes | 07 or 08 | minus 20.00 |
| yes | any other, or no record in status enrolled | nothing |
| no (a high school campus) | any | nothing |
